name: rugradar
description: Read-only Solana token rug and scam checker: 0-100 risk score with red flags (mint/freeze authority, holder concentration, dev launch history, linked insider wallets, LP lock, honeypot sell test), public wallet scans and wallet-drainer link scans. Free tier needs no key.

RUGRADAR_API_KEY.description: Optional RugRadar Pro key for unlimited checks; leave empty for the free tier

tools.name: check_token
tools.description: Check a Solana token (mint, pump fun / DexScreener link or $TICKER) for rug-pull and scam risk: 0-100 score, red flags and a report link.

tools.name: scan_wallet
tools.description: List the SPL tokens held by a public Solana wallet, riskiest first.

tools.name: scan_link
tools.description: Scan a URL or pasted post text for wallet-drainer and phishing patterns.

tools.name: get_pro_quote
tools.description: Get a payment quote for RugRadar Pro ($9 for 30 days, no auto-renewal).

tools.name: verify_payment_and_get_key
tools.description: Verify a Pro payment on-chain and receive a Pro API key.

tools.name: get_pro_status
tools.description: Check a Pro key's validity, expiry and current limits.

tools.name: watch_token
tools.description: Pro: add a token to the agent watchlist with a baseline snapshot.

tools.name: unwatch_token
tools.description: Pro: remove a token from the agent watchlist.

tools.name: get_watch_status
tools.description: Pro: report changes on watched tokens since their baseline (dev selling, liquidity pulled, etc.).

npm.description: Local stdio server (thin client for the RugRadar API)

remote.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint, no auth for the free tier; send a Pro key as Authorization: Bearer <key>

examples.title: Check a token
examples.description: Rug-risk check for a Solana token
